name: file_search
description:
Searches text files in a local directory for a literal query. Returns bounded matching paths, line numbers, and excerpts while respecting common ignored directories.
Use when: locating data fields, config values, references, or documentation across a project.
Scope: local filesystem only. Read-only. Searches at most 2,000 files and returns at most 200 matches.
Not for: scanning for secrets or PII (use repo_scanner), or searching remote repositories.

query.description: Literal text to match, case-insensitively by default.

max_results.description: Maximum matches to return. Default: 50. Max: 200.
